method: CUA Chrome; original screenshot JPEG decoded to PNG without resizing or pixel edits. Scroll used solely to frame actual DOM.
scope: Controlled local fixtures only; API keys and webhook secrets are fake in-memory values. No live account, team, credential or database mutations.
controlledOwnerTransitions: A settled then B pending clears A data/team immediately
B settled; guest clears account data with no new reads
A failure cleared at B switch
Late A failure does not replace B data
Close/reopen removes prior team while membership refresh is pending
